version_overrides: MARKETING_VERSION=1.4.0 and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=39 in the ignored local development spec; not a public release tag.
scope: Current shared Linux runtime and iPad interpreter, plus iOS framework linkage and terminal viewport fixes.
runtime_delta: Only the audio build recipe changes: AudioUnit is linked on macOS; iOS uses AudioToolbox. Runtime execution code is identical to the Mac 1.4.0 base.
fixes: Link the Apple audio and video frameworks from the Xcode app target; iOS has no separate AudioUnit framework.
Anchor the workspace to UIKeyboardLayoutGuide instead of reconstructing keyboard height from notifications. The status row remains above the hardware-keyboard accessory and extended keyboard.
Fit the terminal scroll view height to complete native text rows. Leave the fractional remainder outside the scroll view so bottom clamping cannot reveal a partial history line at the top.
physical_observations: App opens the Alpine shell. A real terminal command reports aarch64.
In build 38, seq 1 60 reaches the last prompt and clear reveals a partial history line at the top.
In build 39, seq 1 60 and clear show complete top/bottom rows without that partial history line.
The status row remains visible above the accessory; expanding and closing the original extended keyboard preserves the layout.
The app is left open at an idle terminal; Device Hub keyboard capture is restored to off.
limits: This is a developer-signed device package; signing profiles and device identifiers remain local.
iPad executes guest CPU instructions with the interpreter, while the Mac benchmark uses HVF. No iPad Geekbench score or speed comparison is claimed.
These are targeted build/layout checks, not new full Firefox, GPU, audio/video, File Provider editing or distribution acceptance. Unchanged runtime suites are reused.
